name: validate_input_character_class
description: Checks the input byte against a classification table entry chosen by a second index. For entries in one range any non-zero byte is accepted, while for the other entries only the codes 4, 8, 12 and space pass, and anything else returns a failure code.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero immediately without reading or writing any state. Several handler pointers point at it, so it acts as a no-op target.

name: update_record_coordinate_fields
description: Branches on a flag byte in the record, and in either branch stores a table-derived value and a masked sum of two stored bytes into record fields, calling routines for each value. It then adds two more routine results into a final record field.

name: add_byte_into_record_field
description: Stores one byte returned by a routine into a record field, then adds a second routine's byte to that same field.

name: find_matching_table_index_backward
description: Scans a 32-entry table from its last index downward for a non-zero entry equal to two bytes of the current record. It returns the first matching index, or a not-found code of 255 when no entry matches.

name: search_table_backward_from_index
description: Starts at the index passed in and walks the table downward, returning the first non-zero entry that matches two bytes of the current record. It returns a not-found code of 255 if the walk passes the first entry.

name: draw_heading_status_text
description: Sets two text-position fields, writes a value derived from the record into a global, and calls drawing routines, with a four-way choice on a record byte selecting the level text. The referenced strings '-WEST, HEAD-' and 'LVL:00' show it draws a heading and level status line.

name: forward_compass_label_draw
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control straight through. The referenced strings EAST, NORTH and SOUTH suggest it forwards to the compass label drawing.

name: run_routines_gated_by_flag
description: Calls one routine, then calls a second routine only when a flag byte in the record is non-zero, then calls a third routine. The gate lets the middle step be skipped without changing the others.

name: run_fixed_routine_call_sequence
description: Runs a fixed sequence of calls to other routines, grouping them under local flags that are cleared before being tested, so the same calls run in the same order each time. It returns early after the first group.

name: dispatch_status_bits_after_setup
description: Stores the input byte and table values into the record, then reads a status byte from a routine. Depending on its bits it sets a direction flag and calls further routines, and it returns zero after dispatching.

name: walk_line_steps_from_table
description: Loads eight step parameters for the entry chosen by the input byte into the record, then repeatedly calls a routine while advancing a position value and two accumulators. Each accumulator reloads when it reaches zero, and the walk ends when the step count runs out.

name: apply_bit_mask_to_bitplanes
description: Clears or sets bits across the bitplanes at one column, stepping one 40-byte row at a time from a start row up to a limit stored in the record. A space in the record's mode byte selects clearing with the routine's bits, and otherwise the bits are set, touching one plane or all four depending on a sign test.

name: lookup_rotating_table_byte
description: Adds a fixed offset to a record byte, keeps the low three bits of the sum, and returns the table entry at that position. The result is one of eight table values.

name: overlay_pattern_rows_into_bitplanes
description: Looks up a four-value entry for the record's index and copies its values into the record. For each step in the range it ORs a routine's byte into the bitplanes at that column across the row limit, repeating until the index reaches its limit.

name: draw_table_driven_segments
description: Reads eight table values for the record's index and issues a series of draw calls at offsets derived from them. When the record's flag is set, each offset is replaced by its distance from 127, which reflects the shape.

name: draw_line_between_coordinates
description: Computes the horizontal and vertical distances and direction signs between two stored coordinates. It then steps along the longer axis, calling a routine at each step while an accumulator advances the shorter axis.

name: step_line_with_precomputed_horizontal
description: Recomputes the vertical distance from two stored coordinates and performs the same accumulator-based line stepping. It relies on the horizontal distance already stored in the record.

name: step_line_using_stored_deltas
description: Runs accumulator-based line stepping using horizontal and vertical distances already stored in the record. It chooses the major axis from whichever distance is larger and calls a routine at each step.

name: step_line_vertical_major_axis
description: Runs one accumulator-based stepping loop along the longer distance stored in the record. The vertical coordinate advances on every step, and the horizontal coordinate advances whenever the accumulator overflows.

name: set_pixel_bit_in_bitplanes
description: Works out the byte and bit position for a pixel from two record coordinates, then sets or clears that bit across all four bitplanes according to a global flag.

name: render_cell_colour_grid
description: Walks a 16-by-16 cell grid, reading a code for each cell from a routine and mapping it to one of six colour values for a drawing routine. After the scan it draws a closing set of cells and stores a final colour value.

name: draw_colour_cells_until_end
description: Maps an incoming code to a colour value and draws it, then walks a 16-by-16 cell grid reading a code for each cell. The scan stops when a particular end code comes back from the routine.

name: scan_colour_grid_row_breaks
description: Walks a 16-by-16 cell grid, reading a code for each cell and mapping the codes to colour values. Two codes are handled separately to end the current row or the scan, and each cell is drawn through a routine.

name: scan_grid_cells_by_code
description: Walks a 16-by-16 cell grid and, for each cell, reads a code from a routine and maps it to a colour value drawn through another routine. Some codes break out to the row or scan level.

name: scan_grid_partial_palette
description: Scans a 16-by-16 cell grid for colour codes, mapping each to one of a few colour values and drawing it. A fixed set of codes breaks the row or scan loop.

name: scan_grid_extended_palette
description: Walks a 16-by-16 cell grid, mapping each code it reads to one of several colour values and drawing it. More codes are handled separately before the row break than in the smaller palette variant.

name: scan_grid_full_palette
description: Walks a 16-by-16 cell grid through nested loops, mapping each code it reads to one of six colour values. Every code has its own branch, and the scan ends with a closing set of draw calls.

name: run_paired_draw_calls_loop
description: Sets two position fields from the record, calls a routine, then alternates pairs of calls in a loop until a flag returned by a routine ends it. It finishes by storing a fixed colour value.

name: scan_sixty_four_cell_grid
description: Scans a 64-cell grid row by row, reading codes from a routine and mapping each to a colour value, with the higher codes issuing paired draw calls. It saves and restores a buffer pointer around the scan.

name: scan_grid_codes_sixty_four
description: Scans a 64-cell grid, reading a code for each cell and mapping it to a colour value that a routine draws. When the grid is exhausted it swaps two stored buffer pointers, issues alternating draw calls, and returns.

name: scan_grid_codes_first_colour
description: Stores and draws a fixed colour value first, then scans the 64-cell grid reading a code per cell and mapping it to a colour value. At the end of the grid it swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls before returning.

name: scan_grid_codes_second_start
description: Begins by storing a second fixed colour value and drawing it, then scans the 64-cell grid mapping each code to a colour value. The end-of-grid handling swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls.

name: scan_grid_codes_third_start
description: Draws a fixed colour value twice before scanning the 64-cell grid, mapping each code it reads to a colour value. The end-of-grid handling swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls.

name: scan_grid_codes_fourth_start
description: Stores a fixed colour value and draws it twice before scanning the 64-cell grid, with codes branching to colour and draw calls. It finishes by drawing a closing colour value and returning.

name: scan_grid_codes_fifth_start
description: Stores a fixed colour value, then scans the 64-cell grid reading a code per cell and mapping it to a colour value with a branch for each code. The end-of-grid handling swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls.

name: scan_grid_codes_sixth_start
description: Stores a fixed colour value and loops over the 64-cell grid, mapping each code it reads to a colour value and drawing it. Codes that match a particular value jump back into the loop, and the end-of-grid handling swaps buffer pointers before returning.

name: run_four_routine_calls
description: Calls four other routines in order and returns, with no branching or stored state of its own.

name: scan_grid_codes_seventh_start
description: Stores a fixed colour value and scans the 64-cell grid, mapping each code it reads to a colour value. A space code draws a separate colour pair, and the end-of-grid handling swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls.

name: scan_grid_codes_eighth_start
description: Stores a fixed colour value and scans the 64-cell grid, mapping each code to a colour value with a branch for each code. A space code draws a pair of calls, and the end-of-grid handling swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls.

name: scan_grid_codes_ninth_start
description: Walks the 64-cell grid and, for each cell, reads a code and maps it to a colour value. A space code stores a separate colour value and issues two draw calls, and the end-of-grid handling swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls.

name: scan_grid_codes_row_resume
description: Advances a row counter and, once the grid is exhausted, swaps buffer pointers and issues alternating draw calls. Otherwise it reads codes for the remaining cells, maps each to a colour value, and draws it through a routine.

name: wait_for_negative_status_byte
description: Calls a routine up to two thousand four hundred times and returns the first negative byte it reports. If no negative value appears in that many calls, it returns zero.

name: plot_pixel_from_record_coords
description: Scales two record coordinates by two, adds offsets, and works out the byte and bit position for a pixel. It then sets or clears that bit across all four bitplanes according to a global flag.

name: run_init_calls_and_wait
description: Calls a routine six times in a fixed loop, stores two constant bytes into a global, then runs a sequence of calls with conditional branches. It finishes by repeating one call while a routine keeps returning one.

name: return_without_any_effect
description: Consists of a single return with no calls, memory writes or register changes, so it does nothing. Its callers receive control back immediately.

name: find_free_record_and_forward
description: Scans a table of 24-byte records for one whose flag byte at offset 16 is clear, then passes that record and the two parameters to another routine. It returns zero when no free record is found.

name: forward_record_if_not_end
description: Compares a stored pointer with the table end value and returns zero when the end is reached. Otherwise it passes the record's two parameters and the pointer on to another routine.

name: forward_record_parameters
description: Passes two parameters and a record pointer on to another routine and then returns without a value.

name: parse_file_mode_and_open
description: Closes any stream already attached to the record, then reads the first character of a mode string as read, write or append. It takes update, binary and text markers from the following characters, opens the file through a routine and fills in stream fields on success. It returns a null result for an unknown mode or a failed open.

name: open_file_from_mode_string
description: Reads the mode string's first character and its following markers to choose read, write or append flags, then calls an open routine. On success it sets the stream record's fields, and it returns a null result when the mode is unknown or the open fails.

name: open_file_update_seek_end
description: Opens a file with an update flag, moves to the end of it, and records the open mode before finishing the stream record. It returns a null result when the open fails.

name: seek_end_and_finish_stream
description: Seeks to the end of the open file, records the mode, and completes the stream record. It is a shared finishing block that other open paths fall into.

name: complete_stream_record_setup
description: Stores mode value two in the record and completes the stream record, setting a buffered flag when a global table entry is set. It returns the record.

name: open_file_and_finish_stream
description: Opens a file using a flag chosen by the update marker, records the mode, and completes the stream record. It returns a null result if the open fails.

name: open_plain_file_stream
description: Opens a file in plain mode, records the handle and mode, and completes the stream record. It returns a null result if the open fails.

name: finish_stream_with_mode_flag
description: Sets the mode value to one, or to a high-bit flag when the marker is present, then completes the stream record. It returns the record.

name: finish_stream_mode_one
description: Sets the mode value to one and completes the stream record, using a buffered flag from a global table. It returns the record.

name: open_file_with_create_flags
description: Opens a file with create-style flags chosen by the update marker, then records the handle and mode and completes the stream record. It returns a null result if the open fails.

name: open_file_write_flags_stream
description: Opens a file with write-style flags, records the handle and mode, and completes the stream record. It returns a null result if the open fails.

name: finish_stream_mode_two_flag
description: Sets the mode value to two, or to a high-bit flag when the marker is present, and completes the stream record. It returns the record.

name: finish_stream_mode_two_plain
description: Sets the mode value to two and completes the stream record using the handle already held in the frame, without opening anything. It returns the record.

name: complete_stream_record_only
description: Completes the stream record from values already in the frame, setting a buffered flag when a global table entry is set. It returns the record.

name: reset_stream_record_fields
description: Clears the record's buffer pointer, then fills its handle, buffer and mode fields from values in the frame. It returns the record.

name: release_record_links_and_flags
description: Releases a record by calling a routine on it when a flag bit is set, then calling a routine on its stored pointer when no other flag bits are set and that pointer is present. It clears the pointer fields and flag byte and finishes by calling a routine with a byte from the record.

name: resolve_table_pointer_checked
description: Checks the input index against a stored limit and maps it through a routine, calling one first when a global flag is set. If a flag bit in the global table is set it returns a pointer to the entry found by a second routine, otherwise it stores an error code of nine and returns a null pointer.

name: open_file_into_free_slot
description: Searches the file table for a free slot, records access bits from the flags, and removes any existing file first when a delete flag is set. It then opens the file through the operating system, and on failure it stores the system error, frees the slot and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the slot index.

name: open_file_in_given_slot
description: Records access bits for a slot the caller already chose, removes the existing file first when a delete flag is set, and opens it through the operating system. It returns the slot on success, or minus one after storing the system error on failure.

name: open_file_in_preallocated_slot
description: Records access bits for a slot the caller allocated earlier, removes the existing file when a delete flag is set, and opens it through the operating system. It returns the slot or minus one, with the system error stored on failure.

name: open_file_marking_slot_used
description: Marks a slot as in use, records access bits from the flags, and removes the existing file when a delete flag is set. It then opens the file through the operating system and returns minus one after storing the system error if the open fails.

name: open_file_with_write_bits
description: Sets the write-access bits for a slot, removes the existing file when a delete flag is set, and opens it through the operating system. It returns minus one after storing the system error if the open fails.

name: open_file_set_write_access
description: Sets a fixed write-access bit on the slot, removes the existing file when a delete flag is set, and opens it through the operating system. It returns minus one after storing the system error if the open fails.

name: open_file_read_write_bits
description: Sets read-write access bits on the slot, adding an extra bit taken from the flags, then removes the existing file when a delete flag is set. It opens the file through the operating system and returns minus one after storing the system error on failure.

name: open_file_fixed_read_write
description: Sets a fixed read-write access value on the slot, removes the existing file when a delete flag is set, and opens it through the operating system. It returns minus one after storing the system error if the open fails.

name: reject_invalid_open_mode
description: Clears the slot, stores an invalid-argument error code of twenty-two, and returns minus one, rejecting an unsupported access mode.

name: open_file_with_flag_mode
description: Removes the existing file when a delete flag is set, then opens it through the operating system using a create or update mode chosen by a flag. It returns minus one after storing the system error if the open fails.

name: open_existing_file_mode
description: Opens a file in old-file mode through the operating system and records the handle on the slot. It returns minus one after storing the system error if the open fails.

name: return_frame_slot_value
description: Returns the value held in the caller's frame without any other work.

name: forward_open_with_fixed_flags
description: Clears the high status bit in the flags argument, sets a fixed combination of access bits, and passes the first argument and the modified flags on to another routine. It returns that routine's result.

name: read_bytes_from_stream
description: Looks up the stream for the given slot and reads the requested number of bytes into the buffer through the operating system. On a read failure it stores the system error and an I/O error code of five, and it returns minus one with an invalid-argument code of twenty-two for a negative count or an unknown stream.

name: read_into_frame_buffer
description: Reads bytes using the stream and buffer held in the caller's frame and returns the count. On failure it stores the system error and an I/O error code of five before returning.

name: write_bytes_to_stream
description: Looks up the stream for the given slot, seeks to its end first when an append bit is set, and writes the requested bytes through the operating system. It stores the system error and an I/O error code of five on failure, and returns minus one with an invalid-argument code of twenty-two for a negative count or an unknown stream.

name: seek_stream_by_table_offset
description: Looks up the stream for the given slot and, when the index is below three, seeks to the offset stored in a global table entry before rewinding to the start. It returns the position from that rewind, and it records the system error on a failed seek.

name: close_stream_unless_flagged
description: Looks up the stream record for the given slot and returns success without closing when a flag bit is set. Otherwise it closes the stream's handle, clears the record's status byte, and returns success, or minus one when the record is missing.

name: delete_named_file
description: Deletes the named file through the operating system and returns zero on success. On failure it stores the system error and an error code of two, then returns minus one.

name: return_zero_without_effect
description: Returns zero with no other effect.

name: open_global_file_handle
description: Opens the file named by a global string in old-file mode and stores the resulting handle in a global variable. It returns nothing.

name: read_byte_with_pushback
description: Returns a byte previously held in a global and clears it when one is pending, otherwise reads the next byte from the open file. It first calls other routines when a global flag is set or no file is open.

name: read_single_byte_from_file
description: Reads one byte from the open file into a local slot and returns it.

name: write_single_byte_to_file
description: Writes the given byte to the open file and returns it. It first calls other routines when a global flag is set or no file is open.

name: push_back_byte_once
description: Stores the given byte as the pending byte for the next read and returns it, or returns minus one when a pending byte is already held.

name: copy_argument_byte_to_global
description: Stores the low byte of a parameter from the caller's frame into a global variable and returns it without further work.

name: close_open_handles_then_forward
description: Closes each open file handle in the table whose status flag is clear, using a count held in a global, then passes the two parameters on to another routine.

name: open_intuition_library_request
description: Opens the intuition library, stores its handle, and shows an auto request dialog sized 250 by 40. It then calls another routine with the value twenty.

name: dispatch_player_input_codes
description: Runs a long loop that reads a code from a routine at each step and dispatches it by value. Some codes move a position through a direction table kept within a four-step cycle, while others trigger drawing and state updates.

name: handle_direction_codes_and_move
description: Runs a per-step loop that reads an input code and, for direction codes, adjusts a position by a signed step and checks it against a zero to ten range before committing it. Other codes take separate branches that update stored state values.

name: poll_input_codes_and_move
description: Repeats the same input-code dispatch as its neighbour: it reads each code, moves a position for direction codes within bounds, and updates stored state for the other codes. It makes a call to an empty routine along the way.

name: scan_active_flags_and_draw
description: Part of the same input and state loop: it moves a position by a signed step within bounds and scans a list of active flags. For each active entry it sets a state byte and calls drawing routines, with extra handling for one particular byte value.

name: dispatch_signed_input_codes
description: Dispatches a signed input code through a chain of comparisons. Some codes set a state byte and call routines, and others fall through to a shared movement and drawing sequence in the same loop.

name: run_shared_move_and_draw
description: Enters the shared body of the update loop directly, updating a state byte and reading a code for the active entry. It draws the entries whose flags are set, using the same flag scan as its neighbours.

name: step_position_and_draw_entry
description: Moves the position by stored steps, rechecks a bounds value, and updates a state byte before drawing. It then continues the same flag-scan loop as the neighbouring routines.

name: update_entry_state_from_code
description: Stores an input code into an entry's state byte, then checks it for zero and for a sign. On the zero path it runs table lookups and draw calls that set the entry's position and status byte, then continues the shared flag-scan loop.

name: check_flag_and_threshold_call
description: Checks a flag bit and a state byte against the threshold forty-five. When both match it calls one routine and returns, and otherwise it calls another routine and returns.

name: run_shared_state_update_tail
description: Writes the state and table-derived bytes for the current entry, then runs the shared flag-scan and drawing loop that follows the other entry points.

name: compare_entry_threshold_and_update
description: Compares a table value against an entry threshold and, when the comparison passes or ties, stores a table-derived value into the entry and clears a global entry. It returns in either case.

name: select_frames_from_input_codes
description: Sets a state byte, then chooses a sequence of table-driven frames by reading input codes in loops, with a range check on each code. The chosen codes are written into the entry's state fields.

name: scan_entry_flags_and_advance
description: Resets the entry counter and scans a flag list from the top for a non-zero entry. It then advances the counter and draws the active entries, returning to the shared loop when the scan finishes.

name: find_entry_matching_position
description: Adds two step offsets to a stored position, checks the result against a ten-cell limit, and searches a table backward for an entry with the same two coordinates. On a match it stores that index for the entry.

name: handle_special_state_codes
description: Branches on a state byte with special values, calling routines for each. It then checks the entry's counters before calling drawing routines and continuing the loop.

name: handle_code_46_branch
description: Handles the input code 46 branch of the shared loop by running the entry checks and draw calls that follow it. It then rejoins the shared counter update.

name: check_entry_and_draw_frame
description: Runs a block of entry checks and draw calls, updating a global and the entry's frame data. It then rejoins the shared update loop.

name: draw_entry_and_clear_flag
description: Computes and stores a sign-based value for the entry, sets a global to cleared, and draws the entry at its coordinates. It then rejoins the shared update loop.

name: draw_entry_and_advance_counter
description: Advances a counter and reads a code. When a sign test passes it resets a global and draws the entry at its stored coordinates before rejoining the shared loop.

name: pick_entry_slot_value
description: Reads a routine value and uses its low three bits to pick one of the entry's seven slot bytes, then returns a combined value. It clears the chosen slot byte when that byte is non-zero.

name: return_after_four_calls
description: Calls four other routines in order and returns, with no branching or stored state of its own.

name: select_entry_value_from_code
description: Reads a routine value and checks its low two bits. When they are clear it calls a routine and rewrites one entry byte with a fixed code if that byte holds a particular value, then returns the value.

name: skip_global_string_entries
description: Steps past a count of null-terminated strings held in a global block, then calls a routine and returns.

name: skip_global_string_entries_again
description: Steps past a count of null-terminated strings held in a global block, then calls a routine and returns, matching its neighbour.

name: skip_string_entries_by_pointer
description: Advances a pointer past a count of null-terminated strings, then calls a routine and returns.

name: apply_scaled_motion_codes
description: When an input code falls in a fixed range, doubles the entry's stored step values into its position. When the next code is a dollar sign it sets a draw code to a space, and otherwise it follows branches that call routines and update state bytes.

name: apply_motion_codes_with_mask
description: Similar to its neighbour: when a code falls in range it doubles the step values into the position. It then tests another routine's value against a mask before choosing among the state branches.

name: apply_motion_and_table_scan
description: Doubles step values into the position when the code is in range, then, when a mask test passes, prepares to scan a global table for a marker. It then calls routines to finish the update.

name: replace_marker_entries_in_table
description: Scans a 64-entry global table backward and replaces each entry equal to the letter H with the value 192. It then calls routines and branches on a mode byte.

name: apply_motion_for_code_range
description: Accepts an input code only when it falls inside a fixed range, then doubles the step values into the position. When the next code is a dollar sign it sets a draw code, and it then writes the entry's state byte before continuing with its branches.

name: check_tile_letter_and_branch
description: Branches on a state byte and checks a map-cell letter against L and against a low-nibble mask. It calls routines for each outcome before continuing the entry update.

name: check_map_letter_for_entry
description: Checks a map cell letter against L and a low-nibble mask, then calls routines depending on the result. It continues the entry update with the chosen state.

name: test_cell_at_offset_position
description: Applies a step offset to the entry's position and, when the input code is in range, reads the map cell there. A cell holding an at-sign triggers a position test, and other results follow separate branches that call routines.

name: test_cell_offset_without_range
description: Applies a step offset to the entry's position and reads the map cell there without a range check. A cell holding an at-sign triggers a position test, and other results follow separate branches.

name: test_special_cell_position
description: Checks whether the global cell value is I and whether the entry sits at one specific position, which selects a branch. Otherwise it calls routines and branches again on a stored value.

name: update_entry_after_cell_test
description: Runs after a cell test: when a flag is not set it tests a cell value against a constant and calls a routine that stores the entry's state. It then rejoins the update loop.

name: commit_entry_state_after_test
description: Stores the entry's movement state into globals after a test, then checks a special global value against a constant. It calls routines that set the entry's position before rejoining the update branches.

name: commit_entry_state_and_branch
description: Copies the entry's state into a global and runs the same test and branch sequence as its neighbours, rejoining the update loop.

name: commit_entry_state_and_rejoin
description: Calls routines that finish a special-value branch, copies the entry state into globals, and rejoins the update branches that test the state byte.

name: check_letter_set_state_eight
description: Checks a map-cell letter against L and, when it matches, sets a global to eight. It then calls routines based on the entry's stored values before continuing.

name: test_cell_low_nibble_branch
description: Tests the low nibble of a map-cell value and calls a routine when it is zero or takes the other path otherwise. It then rejoins the update branches that test the state byte.

name: rejoin_state_branch_update
description: Tests the entry's state byte and branches among routines, rejoining the update loop when the state is unchanged.

name: advance_bcd_counter_with_cap
description: Sets a global to eight and compares an entry counter with a limit. It then advances the counter in decimal-coded steps capped at thirty-seven, calling routines for each branch before rejoining the update.

name: advance_bcd_counter_branch
description: Sets a global to eight and checks an entry counter against thresholds. It advances the counter in decimal-coded steps and calls routines for each branch.

name: advance_bcd_counter_capped_path
description: Sets a global to eight and runs a decimal-coded counter step capped at thirty-seven. It then calls routines for the branch that follows.

name: step_bcd_counter_when_low
description: When an input value is below thirty-seven, advances an entry's decimal-coded counter, capped at thirty-seven, unless a flag or a small value blocks it. It then rejoins the state branches.

name: step_bcd_counter_guarded
description: Advances an entry's decimal-coded counter when a guard test passes, capping the result at thirty-seven. It then calls routines and rejoins the state branches.

name: step_bcd_counter_capped
description: Advances the entry's decimal-coded counter by one step, capping it at thirty-seven. It then calls routines and rejoins the state branches.

name: rejoin_state_test_and_branch
description: Checks the entry's state byte, branching to routines for each state value before rejoining the update branches.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_on_match
description: When a value equals a specific code, decrements the entry's decimal-coded counter if it is non-zero. It calls routines on both paths before rejoining the update.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_checked
description: Checks a code against a fixed value and, on a match, decrements the entry's decimal-coded counter when it is non-zero. It then calls routines and rejoins the update branches.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_then_set
description: Decrements the entry's decimal-coded counter when it is non-zero, then stores a doubled table value into the entry. It calls routines before rejoining the update.

name: set_bcd_counter_from_input
description: Stores the input value minus one as a decimal-coded counter in the entry, then stores a doubled table value. It calls routines before rejoining the update.

name: advance_index_modulo_four
description: Advances a two-bit index modulo four, then copies the matching table entry into two globals. It calls routines and rejoins the update.

name: choose_entry_slot_by_code
description: Stores a small code minus one as an entry index when it is below five, then reads codes in a loop until one falls in range. It then calls routines that continue the update.

name: choose_entry_slot_from_input
description: Accepts an input value only when it is below five, stores it minus one as an entry index, and reads codes in a loop until the value is in range. It then calls routines and rejoins the update.

name: store_entry_slot_when_nonzero
description: Computes an entry slot value from the input and checks the matching table entry, branching when that table slot is empty. When it is not empty the slot is stored in the entry and the update continues.

name: store_entry_slot_and_rejoin
description: Calls routines, stores the chosen slot into the entry, then rejoins the state-dependent update branches.

name: store_code_if_below_limit
description: Stores the input byte and finds the entry's code in an eleven-entry table. It returns early when the input is not 200 and the matching table value does not exceed it.

name: shift_code_and_set_marker
description: Checks a stored code against two fixed values. When the code differs from both and a routine's value is small, it doubles the code into the entry and sets a marker value.

name: shift_code_and_rejoin
description: Doubles a stored code into the entry when a routine's value is below five, sets a marker value, and rejoins the update branches.

name: store_doubled_code_marker
description: Stores a doubled code into the entry, sets a marker value, and rejoins the state branches.

name: scan_input_for_marker_codes
description: Clears a counter and reads input codes in a loop until a marker code appears, then sets a count of eight. Codes that adjust the counter take their own branches along the way.

name: rejoin_state_branch_dispatch
description: Tests the entry's state byte and branches among routines, rejoining the update loop.

name: toggle_entry_code_pair
description: When a counter is zero and a flag bit in the entry is set, toggles a stored code between two fixed values. It then calls routines and rejoins the update.

name: set_entry_code_and_rejoin
description: Stores a fixed code into the entry, calls routines, and rejoins the state-dependent update branches.

name: set_code_to_alternate_value
description: Stores a second fixed code into the entry, calls routines, and rejoins the state-dependent update branches.

name: run_three_calls_and_rejoin
description: Calls three routines in order and then rejoins the state-dependent update branches.

name: mask_code_and_test_zero
description: Masks the input code to its low seven bits and stores it. It then continues into the state branches, taking a special path when the entry byte is non-zero.

name: rejoin_state_branch_checks
description: Calls routines and tests the entry's state byte, branching among update paths before continuing the loop.

name: loop_codes_until_zero_entry
description: Loops reading a code until a counter reaches zero. For counter values below twenty it stores a table-derived value, offset by a fixed amount, into the entry before calling routines.

name: draw_bcd_status_digits
description: Sets a global flag and a fixed colour value, then sets two position fields. It draws a decimal-coded counter from the entry plus one and calls routines for the remaining draw steps.

name: run_table_driven_draw_records
description: Walks a table of three-byte records until a negative marker, setting two position fields from each record and calling a routine as many times as the record's count.

name: draw_slot_list_with_highlight
description: Sets up a table of slot records, then loops over the slots, positioning each one and choosing its colour. The slot matching the entry's selected value gets a highlight colour.

name: draw_row_list_with_highlight
description: Similar to its neighbour: it sets up pointer records and loops over rows, positioning each one. The row matching the entry's current value gets a highlight colour.

name: advance_draw_position_and_return
description: Calls two routines, increments a position field by one, and returns.

name: increment_draw_position_and_return
description: Calls a routine, increments a position field by one, and returns.

name: draw_bitmask_selected_items
description: Reads pairs of values and tests the entry's bit mask at each bit index. When the bit is set it sets position fields and calls a routine to draw that item.

name: repeat_draw_calls_by_count
description: Runs a loop a number of times set by its input, calling two routines on each pass, and then returns.

name: measure_null_terminated_length
description: Counts bytes from the given pointer until a zero byte and returns that count.

name: prepare_stream_for_access
description: Checks a stream record's status bits and returns minus one when access is blocked. Otherwise it may call a routine to set up the buffer, then marks the stream as in use.

name: prepare_stream_from_frame
description: Performs the same stream status checks as its neighbour, reading the stream from the caller's frame before calling a routine to set up the buffer.

name: mark_stream_in_use_read
description: Checks the stream's status bits and marks it in use. It stores the buffer position from the record, or a default count, and calls a routine with the stream's mode byte.

name: mark_stream_and_call_routine
description: Blocks on a status bit, marks the stream active, and calls a routine with its mode, handle and buffer values.

name: mark_stream_buffer_active
description: Marks a stream as active, stores its buffer values, and calls a routine to fill from them. It returns that routine's result.

name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Decrements the stream's remaining count and returns the next byte from its buffer. When the count runs out it calls a routine to refill the buffer first.

name: flush_stream_and_return
description: Calls a routine on the stream and returns without a value.

name: put_stream_byte_checked
description: Checks a stream's status bits and, when the stream can take data, stores the low byte of the value into its buffer. It calls a routine when the buffer is full and returns minus one for blocked streams.

name: init_stream_buffer_once
description: Returns zero when the stream already has a buffer and the flag is clear. Otherwise it allocates a buffer through a routine and records it in the stream record, storing an out-of-memory error code of twelve and returning minus one if allocation fails.

name: parse_signed_number_text
description: Skips an optional minus sign, then consumes characters from a class table that match digit and decimal point rules. It returns the parsed value.

name: format_numeric_field_padded
description: Formats a numeric field for a printf-style routine, computing padding from the width and precision values held in the frame. It then writes the digits and fill through the output buffer writers.

name: format_alternate_field_padded
description: Performs the same field formatting as its neighbour for the alternate form, setting width and precision, and writes the padded output through the buffer writers.

name: compute_field_padding_width
description: Computes the padding count from the width and precision values in the frame, then calls the buffer writers to emit the fill and the value.

name: write_padding_characters
description: Writes a fill character into the output buffer for a counted number of positions, advancing the buffer pointer each time.

name: write_fill_characters_loop
description: Writes a fill character into the output buffer repeatedly, then writes a padded run from a second source, advancing the buffer pointer for each character.

name: copy_string_chars_to_buffer
description: Copies characters from a source string into the output buffer one at a time, counting the length down and advancing the buffer pointer for each character.

name: return_formatted_length
description: Stores the count of characters written into the caller's result slot and returns the buffer position just past the end of the output.

name: format_float_default_precision
description: Sets the precision to six when none was given, caps it at nineteen, and converts the value to digits through a routine, as printf-style floating point formatting does.

name: convert_float_digits_to_text
description: Converts a value to a fixed number of digits through a routine, using the precision from the frame, and advances the output pointer past the written characters.

name: emit_float_sign_and_digits
description: Decides whether a sign and decimal point are needed, adjusts the digit count, and writes the characters through the buffer writers.

name: compute_exponent_field_width
description: Works out the width of the exponent part from its decimal value, adding digits when the value passes ninety-nine or nine hundred ninety-nine, then pads the field.

name: count_exponent_digit_places
description: Counts how many digits the exponent needs by comparing it with ninety-nine and nine hundred ninety-nine, then writes the sign and digits.

name: emit_minus_sign_and_digits
description: Writes a minus sign when the value is negative, then writes the integer digits, padding with zeros where the digit count runs out.

name: write_zero_padded_digits
description: Writes digits from the converted value and substitutes zero characters once the digit count is exhausted, until the counter ends.

name: write_trailing_zero_digits
description: Writes zero characters for each remaining position in the field, stopping when the fractional counter reaches its limit.

name: write_fraction_zero_padding
description: Writes zero characters while a counter stays non-negative, using a digit count from the frame, and then returns to the float formatter.
